thread.title: Apple HomePod Available Feb. 9 After Missing Holiday Season

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Apple HomePod Available Feb. 9 After Missing Holiday Season
text:
Apple 's ( AAPL ) voice-activated wireless music speaker, HomePod, missed the holiday shopping season but will be available for Valentine's Day, the consumer electronics giant announced Tuesday.
X Consumers who want to queue up Barry White or some other romantic crooner on the device this Feb. 14 will be able to pre-order HomePod online starting this Friday in the U.S., U.K. and Australia. It is expected to arrive in France and Germany in the spring.
The $349 device joins a crowded market for smart speakers, dominated by less expensive devices from Amazon.com ( AMZN ) and Alphabet 's ( GOOGL ) Google. Amazon's Echo line of smart speakers ranges from $49.99 to $229.99. Alphabet sells two types of Google Home, costing $49 and $129.
Apple shares ticked up 4 cents to close at 177.04 on the stock market today . Apple stock hit an all-time high of 180.10 last Thursday.
Apple announced the HomePod on June 5 at the company's Worldwide Developers Conference in San Francisco. At the time, it said the product would be available in December. But it revealed in late November that the HomePod would miss the Christmas shopping season.
